sections.note: Reframed the eigenvalue definition and symmetric-matrix decomposition in vibration and modal-analysis language.
Connected the dominant-eigenvalue assumption to the dominant vibration mode in a structural system.
Kept the update rule and normalisation intact, and linked them to repetitive matrix-vector operations in code.
Retained the Rayleigh quotient and residual, while adding a mechanical interpretation for modal estimation and validation.
Used a compact Python implementation and exercises to connect the algebra to code and to vibration-mode interpretation.

source_issues.issue: The source notes are concise and did not include a structural-vibration application, so the lesson uses a discipline bridge rather than a new mathematical claim.
